audit_items.proof_trace: The route calls `supabase.auth.getUser()` (server-side JWT validation) and passes the resulting `user.id` directly as `p_user_id` to the RPC; this value is never derived from user-controlled input, so `rpc_user_id == session_user_id` holds unconditionally. The consent ID (`id`) from URL params maps only to `p_consent_id`, not to `p_user_id`, so an attacker cannot substitute another user's identity. The dedicated `p_user_id` parameter on the RPC and the inline comment confirm DB-level ownership filtering is intended.
